items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: Bill Eastwood was playing banjo and Monk I think played drums back there too for a while... I used to talk to him and kind of play banjo.

ctx.x: Well Monk would tell me about Sidney Aarland and Louie.
Oh yeah, he knew much better than me. Yeah. I mean sure Monk knew.
